name: Silent Hill 3
overview:
𝗙𝗢𝗟𝗟𝗢𝗪 𝗦𝗥𝗟𝗭𝗗 @𝗭𝗵𝘂𝘂𝘂

Seventeen years after the harrowing events of the original game, Silent Hill 3 follows Heather Mason, a seemingly normal teenage girl who gets dragged into a terrifying nightmare while running an errand at a local shopping mall. Haunted by grotesque monsters and pursued by a fanatical cult leader named Claudia Wolf, Heather discovers the shocking truth about her hidden birthright and her connection to the town's dark past. To stop the cult from birthing a malicious deity, she must venture deep into the fog-shrouded streets and decaying Otherworld of Silent Hill to claim her vengeance and protect her future.
